notes.text:
Hexapod Pi Zero 2 W wiring, Rev C (5 November 2026).
1. UART: Pi pin 8 (GPIO14 TX) → Servo 2040 SCL (GP21 RX); pin 10 (GPIO15 RX) ← SDA (GP20 TX); pin 6 GND → GND. Do NOT join 3V3.
2. The 5V symbol is the Pi 5 V rail: the buck converter feeds it through PWR IN (micro-USB); the hub takes it from the inner USB port.
3. All grounds are joined: battery −, buck converter, Pi, Servo 2040, hub and LiDAR.
4. Switch the servo power off before connecting or disconnecting anything.

RPLIDAR C1 (planned): connect through its USB adapter and the hub. The Pi’s GPIO UART is used by the Servo 2040 and its other UART by Bluetooth (Xbox controller). 5 V about 230 mA; 3.3 V logic; 460 800 baud. Check the pinout on the Slamtec datasheet.
Servo outputs: L1 = 1–3, L2 = 4–6, L3 = 7–9, R1 = 10–12, R2 = 13–15, R3 = 16–18 (hip, upper leg, lower leg). Each servo plugs into the Servo 2040 header, which carries V+ and GND for it.

customParts.name: Battery pack
customParts.description: Servo supply at the voltage the servos are rated for. Its − is the common ground for the whole robot.

customParts.name: 5 V buck converter, 3 A
customParts.description: Steps the battery down to 5 V for the Pi, the USB hub, the LiDAR and the Servo 2040 logic. 3 A or more.

customParts.name: Pimoroni Servo 2040
customParts.description: RP2040 servo controller running motion_bridge.py. UART1 on the Qw/ST connector: SDA = GP20 (TX), SCL = GP21 (RX). Logic powered from its USB-C port.

customParts.name: Leg servo
customParts.description: One of the 18 leg servos. Plugs into a Servo 2040 output, which carries its signal, V+ and GND.
customParts.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 40 20"><rect x="0.5" y="0.5" width="39" height="19" rx="2" fill="#7c3aed" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="0.6"/><text x="20" y="5" font-size="3" text-anchor="middle" fill="#fff" font-family="sans-serif">Leg servo</text></svg>

customParts.name: USB hub (micro-USB OTG)
customParts.description: Plugs into the Pi’s inner USB port (not PWR IN). Port 1: Servo 2040 logic power. Port 2: LiDAR USB adapter.

customParts.description: USB-to-serial adapter board supplied with the RPLIDAR C1. Gives the LiDAR 5 V and turns its 460 800 baud serial link into USB.

customParts.description: Slamtec RPLIDAR C1: 360° DTOF laser range scanner, 12 m, IP54. 5 V about 230 mA. UART 460 800 baud, 3.3 V logic. Check the pinout on the Slamtec datasheet.
